statement: DRAFT, awaiting maintainer confirmation. Three retained, isolated FLINT patches reduce complete-operation time on selected workloads on one Apple M2 (one FLINT thread, Apple clang 21, -O3 -mcpu=apple-m2): (1) integer squaring: fusing two-prime reconstruction with carry propagation (patches/c3-register-reconstruction.patch) reduces complete squaring CPU time by 3.26% [95% CI 2.99, 3.54] and 3.10% [2.85, 3.34] in two confirmation runs over 4095-16385-limb (about 262k-1M-bit) operands (wall time about 3%); (2) polynomial matrices: preparing each reusable left input once (patches/poly-prepared.patch) reduces CPU time by 4.34-15.09% across all 30 eligible tested cases, with positive intervals in both confirmations; (3) theta evaluation: shared signed transforms and equal-bank specialization (patches/theta-direct-walsh.patch + theta-batch-retained.patch; theta-equal-bank.patch) give median CPU reductions of 3.65-5.84% on nonzero-point batches and 4.38-9.13% on squared constants versus original FLINT. Figures describe different conditions and are not additive.
status: Draft frontier assembled from docs/project-plan.md (lead examples, 2026-10-09). Not yet confirmed by a maintainer.

metric.name: complete integer squaring CPU-time reduction vs unmodified FLINT 657a2839 (confirmation 2)

scope: Apple M2, macOS, one FLINT thread, warm synthetic inputs, FLINT commit 657a2839cf0125164859ff102b1f124abcb87ce0 (deps.json). Selected sizes and workloads only; not an overall FLINT speedup, not another architecture, not a complete downstream application. Patches are experimental and not submitted upstream. The five-patch interpolation/series campaign in docs/review-report.md (FLINT 26b9bc9d) is reported separately and is not part of this record.

assumptions.statement: The gains hold on a second architecture; the C3 patch uses NEON internals and has no portable fallback yet.
The gains survive in a genuine complete downstream caller; current fixtures are synthetic, and the pi workload effect is sub-percent and noisy.
Someone other than the author re-measures at least one lead result on separate Apple Silicon hardware.
FLINT maintainers accept the correctness scope and dispatch conditions of a submitted patch.
